text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wake up early one morning while it's
still dark out. I'm finding it hard to get
back to sleep, so I
decide to take a walk
instead.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. You're one of the academy's
trainers. What
are you doing up this
early?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Why, I'm on a walk! It was such a
pleasant night.
choice_data_list: What about you? What in the world ...
And what on earth are you doing...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Of course I know.
choice_data_list: Isn't being out at this hour again...
Isn't being out at this hour again...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I only meant to take in the fresh night
air
for a
second before heading back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But... look down this road. You see how
far down
the streetlamps go? They're
like a series of
guideposts.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I started to wonder where they led and
what
would happen if I followed them to
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, there I was, counting the lights as I
went. The
sky was vast and silent. It was
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There might have been a meteor shower, 
actually... I saw so many shooting stars
flying past
above the dark town. Then
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My stomach growled something fierce!
My feet hurt, and it was already
morning. So I made my
way back, and
you spotted me! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Let's keep that a secret between us. Getting scolded is so boring.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, enough talk. I could really go
for some
breakfast right now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, would you like to come with? Since
fate has already brought us together, I'd
love to hear what
prompted you to wake
up so early.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That diner over there does a really mean
egg over
rice dish for breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Head back and sleep? You sound like
Rudolf!
choice_data_list: Convince them to go home and rest

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The last time I spent all night out, I got
lectured
for almost a whole hour in the
student council
office.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ugh... That was the most boring thing ever. I just can't. Even thinking about it is making me—yawn...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I think I'll...
go over there for just
a little...
Good night...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: All right. Come on, then!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You were out for a walk because you
couldn't fall back asleep? Guess we
both have a
long and drowsy day ahead
of us.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But you know, now that my belly's warm
and full, I
feel kind of...
